content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-113. - I.B.C. Section 907.5.2.2, Emergency voice/alarm communication.
content.summary:
Sec. 907.5.2.2. Emergency voice/alarm communication,
is hereby amended by adding the following subsection:
"907.5.2.2.6. Intelligibility.
The intelligibility of a voice/alarm communication system shall be tested in an objective
                  manner in accordance with NFPA 72."

is hereby amended by adding the following subsection:
